cues.zh: 这一切并不是从这里开始的。
不是从扰频器或罗夏开始的……
cues.en: Not with the scramblers or Rorschach...

cues.zh: 也不是从大本钟、忒修斯或那些吸血鬼开始的。
cues.en: not with Big Ben or Theseus or the vampires.

cues.zh: 大多数人会说，是从萤火虫开始的，
cues.en: Most people would say it started with the Fireflies,

cues.zh: 它是随着所有那些东西一起终结的。
cues.en: It ended with all those things.

cues.zh: 我已开始受控反应堆停堆……
cues.en: I have begun a controlled reactor shutdown...

cues.zh: ……主驱动将至少离线二十七分钟。
cues.en: ...the main drive will be offline for at least twenty-seven minutes.

cues.zh: ——罗伯特说罗夏是培育出来的。成堆地培育
cues.en: — Robert says Rorschach grows them. In stacks
— The ship grows its own crew?

cues.zh: ——如果它是艘船的话。如果他们是船员的话。
cues.en: — IF it's a ship. IF they're crew.

cues.zh: ——基顿，你面前有东西。就在你和那个大兵之间。你看不见吗？
cues.en: — There's something in front of you, Keeton. Directly between you and the grunt. Can't you see it?
— How can you not see it, it's right...

cues.zh: ——我什么也没看见。它在干什么？
cues.en: — I don't see anything. What's it doing?

cues.zh: — 就……飘在那儿。像是在挥手。哦，靠……Keet……
cues.en: — Just... floating there. Kind of waving. Oh, sh... Keet...

cues.zh: — 哦，对啊。我们这才明白过来。
cues.en: — Oh, right. We get it NOW.

cues.zh: 你不觉得那儿会有人吧？
cues.en: You don't think there's anyone here, do you?

cues.zh: 已知情况不允许再拖了。
cues.en: What we know weighs against further delay.

cues.zh: — 长官，我们连那儿有没有人都不知道。
cues.en: — Sir, we don't even know if there's anyone there.

cues.zh: — 萤火虫组织。我们发现了东西。
来自柯伊伯带的无线电信号。我们追踪到了方位。
cues.en: A radio signal from the Kuiper. We traced the bearing.
All we have is the location.

cues.zh: — 所以你要派一队人过去。
— 我们本该察觉到他们来的。
cues.en: — We should have seen them coming.

cues.zh: — 他们隐形了！— 他们想干什么？
cues.en: — They were stealthed! — What do they want?

cues.zh: — 可他们在哪儿？— 他们会回来吗？
cues.en: — But where are they? — Are they coming back?

cues.zh: 有时我觉得，自己这一生都在努力找回那份联系，
cues.en: Sometimes it seems as though my whole life's been a struggle to reconnect,

cues.zh: 就在父母杀死他们唯一的孩子时。
cues.en: when my parents killed their only child.

cues.zh: 我终于赢得了这场斗争。
多亏了一个吸血鬼和一群怪胎……
cues.en: Thanks to a vampire and a boatload of freaks...
By the time I get home,

cues.zh: 我可能会是宇宙里唯一有意识的存在。
cues.en: I could be the only sentient being in the universe.

cues.zh: 如果我还能算得上有意识的话。
因为我不知道，世上是否真有可靠的叙述者。
cues.en: Because I don't know if there is such a thing as a reliable narrator.
